scope: Single-tab return to owner B after the checked-consent B-to-A test. The separate checked-consent network-change test is staged, not completed.

inputs.question: How long do I have to request a refund?
inputs.draft: Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of purchase.
inputs.consent_label: I checked the content and agree to publish it.
inputs.consent_checked_by: assistant, only in the local unsigned confirmation
inputs.account_switched_by: human via MetaMask, as instructed; observed through the resulting ReplyCheck UI

checks.claim: The first post-return snapshot recognizes B as owner, keeps the original ten-review history, restores approval, and has no revived dialog or recovery warning.
Explicitly opening a fresh answer-card confirmation resets consent to unchecked and disables Continue to wallet.
The local checkbox is checked again only to stage the separate network test; wallet continuation is enabled but never activated.

next_test.expected_ui_condition: A non-Studionet network clears the checked unsigned confirmation and prevents contract actions.

limitations: Human MetaMask interaction is not continuously recorded; the first fresh application UI supplies the observed return-to-B result.
No fresh deployed-source or full-state RPC comparison, new transaction, contract output or reason code is claimed.
Network invalidation, pending identity/network changes, actual cross-tab races and the full release matrix remain open. Observation times are not new chain timestamps.
